fusions.name: Venom Clamp
fusions.desc: Clamps the target, dealing 12 damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Spat Venom
fusions.desc: Spits a bolt of venom that deals 26 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 4 damage a second for 6 seconds. The blow ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Venom Reserve
fusions.desc: Increases your poison damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Waiting Fangs
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
